title: Frozen all the way down
hints: A type alias may refer to itself: apply `readonly` to every key, and for each value, apply `DeepReadonly` again.
You need a base case: primitives stay as they are, and so do functions (a mapped type over a function would wipe out its call signature). Check functions first, then `T extends object`.
type DeepReadonly<T> = T extends (...args: any[]) => any ? T : T extends object ? { readonly [K in keyof T]: DeepReadonly<T[K]> } : T;
